sum: Liquidity Services, Inc. provides e-commerce marketplaces, self-directed auction listing tools, and value-added services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through GovDeals, Retail Supply Chain Group, Capital Assets Group, and Machinio & Software Solutions segments. It provides solutions that enable government entities and commercial businesses to sell surplus property and real estate assets through GovDeals, Bid4Assets, and Sierra marketplaces. The company also offers surplus management, asset valuation, asset sales, marketing, returns management, asset recovery, and ecommerce services; and operates marketplaces to sell excess, returned, and overstocked consumer goods. In addition, it operates Machinio marketplace, a global search engine platform for listing used equipment for sale in the construction, machine tool, processing, transportation, printing, agriculture, and laboratory/medical sectors. Further, the company provides Machinio System platform that offers website hosting, email marketing, and inventory management to equipment sellers, as well as auction platform services to entrepreneurs and businesses. Additionally, it operates an online auction marketplaces comprising Invaluable, a global marketplace for fine art, antiques, jewelry, and collectible; and AuctionZip, a U.S.-focused marketplace and directory for local and regional auctioneers. The company also provides auction houses with private-label auction websites, auction-management software, marketing services, and integrated payment processing; and offers buyers managed shipping and subscription access. It offers its products to consumer electronics, general merchandise, apparel, scientific equipment, aerospace parts and equipment, technology hardware, real estate, energy equipment, industrial capital assets, heavy equipment, fleet and transportation equipment, and specialty equipment. Liquidity Services, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Bethesda, Maryland.
ceo: Mr. William Paul Angrick III (Co-founder, Chairman of the Board of Directors & CEO)
